notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.' Expectation from the text: 'it' is the creature that died (CR 603.10a look-back). Your counterless Plain Bear dies while the Lieutenant itself carries a +1/+1 counter: no Knight. The opponent's Opp Bear with a counter dies: not a creature you control, no Knight. The Lieutenant (4/5 with its counter) dies: it had a counter, so exactly one 2/2 Knight with vigilance.
